projection.source: manual dimensions/transforms extracted from current E source and exact orthographic projection math; not runtime/Godot sampling
projection.rounding: each axis-aligned projected footprint bbox is ceiled independently to integer pixels; exact float bbox and all four projected corners are retained; no source model is scaled
projection.view_axis: Godot viewport top-left origin; projected corners use pixel coordinates
projection.unit: scene units; no claim that these are metres
projection.assumptions: square 1600x1600 capture viewport; orthographic camera size is vertical span; room-relative transforms from current source; no UI crop; flat planes projected without occlusion/clipping correction
projection.purpose: screen-density guide for the fixed authored camera. This is not a physically proportioned top-down texture atlas. Map image left/right and back/front according to the listed projected corners and UV direction; rendered planes are foreshortened by the camera.
